protocol.selection: Maximum worst development-week net, then name; no validation reselection
protocol.acceptance: Both dev weeks >=10 trades and positive net; validation >=30 trades, PF>=1.15, positive net, bootstrap lower95>0, doubled-cost net>0
protocol.ratio: Exactly equal price distances from slipped entry; net reward/risk is lower after costs
protocol.execution: 5bps taker each side, 4bps spread, 2bps slip each side, historical funding; next-bar entry, stop wins intrabar ties

bootstrap.method: IID resampling of whole UTC days, preserving within-day trade correlation; few days limits confidence

stress.method: Same positions, size and exit timestamps; double fees/adverse slippage. Not a replay of changed stops or liquidity.
